decisions.reason: Retaining the 0-ohm I2C series resistors changes bus conditioning but does not alter the interboard signal connector selection or pinout.
The I2C series-resistor decision does not change the separate interboard power connector, pin count, or pin-order rule.
The decision concerns resistors on the I2C bus and does not change native USB data-line behavior.
Retaining the existing I2C series resistors does not modify the established component-sourceability or compatible-alternative policies.
The I2C series-resistor population decision does not change ESP32 clocking, sleep modes, deep-sleep policy, or wake sources.
